item.tib: rig 'dzin stong rgyung mthu chen gyi 'bras bu sprul sku ru sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom thabs dkyil 'khor bsgom thabs
item.coloph: ces lha tshogs rang la rdzogs pas bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i mtshan ma ma mchis kyang / 'on kyang blo rmongs rnams la phan pa'i ched du/ 'bras bu sprul sku ru bsgrub pa'i bskyed rim sgom thabs 'di yang / dad ldan grogs po rnams kyis bskul ngor/ bka' ngag mi ldog tsam du gdung rgyud rgyal po drug gi nang tshan rgod rje rgya yi gdung la dal rten rnyed pa'i tshe dbang bde chen snying po bdag gis bag chags 'khrul pa'i bzang rtags dang bcas bod skad du rnga chen/ ma ha tsi na'i skad du zhing zu'i/ dbang thang dang bstun pa'i chu khyi zla ba 10 tshes 10 la 'phral du spel ba'o//
